description: A discrete round mound about 15 m across and about 1.5 m high, smooth on its west side and irregular on its east side, isolated on flat reclaimed ground. It is left as an open clearing inside a young broadleaf plantation surrounded by arable fields. The 1900 map shows moor or wet heath at the point with no symbol. No registered burial mound lies within 300 m.
alt_question: Is this a heap of sand or spoil left from moor reclamation and ditching, or a natural sand knoll rising through former moor, rather than a burial mound?

Mound left as a clearing inside the plantation

limitations: Only one DGM1 delivery (no epoch comparison).
